reason: A DSH plugin that injects configurable text into outgoing chat requests, with a web toggle and settings-based behavior customization.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天请求中注入可配置文本，并提供网页开关与设置文件配置。
summaries.en: Injects configurable text into DeepSeek Harness chat requests with a web toggle and settings-file configuration.

capabilities: Injects configurable text into outgoing model request payloads
Adds a web-interface toggle for enabling or disabling injection
Supports runtime configuration reload from a settings file
